name: 夏
feature: 传说中首个世袭王朝，「家天下」由此开端；以下据古本竹书纪年约数列主要君主，合计约470年。
featureEn: The first hereditary dynasty in legend; the “family rule” began here. Major rulers listed per the Bamboo Annals, totaling ~470 yrs.
summary: 信史待考，多与二里头考古互证，标志中原早期国家雏形。
summaryEn: Historicity still debated, cross-checked with Erlitou archaeology; marks the dawn of early statehood in the Central Plains.

name: 商
feature: 甲骨文与青铜文明高峰，神权与王权合一；以下据传统王系约数列主要君主，合计约554年。
featureEn: Zenith of oracle-bone script and bronze civilization, with theocratic and royal power fused. Major rulers per the traditional line, ~554 yrs.
summary: 甲骨文证实商王世系，是中国有同期文字记载的最早王朝。
summaryEn: Oracle bones confirm the Shang royal genealogy — the earliest dynasty with contemporaneous written records in China.

name: 周
yearsEn: Western Zhou 1046–771 BC / Eastern Zhou 770–475 BC (Spring & Autumn)
feature: 分封宗法礼乐奠基；平王东迁后王室衰微，春秋争霸、诸侯力政，百家萌芽。列主要王（谥号），合计约571年。
featureEn: Founded feudalism, kinship hierarchy and ritual music; after Ping Wang moved east the royal house declined — the Spring & Autumn hegemons vied, the Hundred Schools germinated. Major kings (posthumous names), ~571 yrs.
summary: 礼乐文明奠基期，春秋变局孕育百家争鸣。
summaryEn: The bedrock of ritual-music civilization; the Spring & Autumn upheaval nurtured the Hundred Schools.

name: 战国
feature: 七雄并立：齐楚燕韩赵魏秦，变法图强、合纵连横；百家争鸣达于鼎盛，儒道墨法交辉。列主要诸子，合计约254年。
featureEn: Seven powers vied — Qi, Chu, Yan, Han, Zhao, Wei, Qin; reforms and vertical/horizontal alliances; the Hundred Schools peaked, with Confucian, Daoist, Mohist and Legalist thought shining. Major thinkers, ~254 yrs.
summary: 大争之世，制度与思想双重井喷，为秦汉一统蓄势。
summaryEn: An age of contention; institutions and thought erupted together, setting the stage for Qin–Han unification.

name: 秦
feature: 中国首个大一统中央集权帝国，制度影响两千年。
featureEn: China's first unified centralized empire; its institutions shaped two millennia.
summary: 虽短祚却确立帝制框架，中央集权范式沿用两千年；秦亡后楚汉相争，旋由汉继统。
summaryEn: Brief yet it established the imperial framework; the centralized paradigm endured for two thousand years; after Qin fell the Chu–Han contention ensued, then Han succeeded.

name: 楚汉相争
capital: 彭城(楚) / 栎阳·长安(汉)
feature: 秦亡后项羽刘邦争天下，鸿门宴、垓下之围，四年而定，刘邦建汉。列主要人物，合计4年。
featureEn: After Qin fell, Xiang Yu and Liu Bang fought for the realm — the Feast at Hong Gate, the encirclement at Gaixia — settled in four years when Liu Bang founded Han. Major figures, 4 yrs.
summary: 平民刘邦胜项羽，开布衣将相之局。
summaryEn: Commoner Liu Bang defeated Xiang Yu, opening an era of officials from humble origins.

name: 汉
feature: 大一统定型，丝路开通，儒术独尊，国号成族称。列主要帝，合计约421年。
featureEn: Unification settled, the Silk Road opened, Confucianism made orthodox, and the dynasty's name became the ethnonym. Major emperors, ~421 yrs.
summary: 奠定中华主体民族认同与集权范式，「汉」成为族称。
summaryEn: Forged the core Han identity and the centralized model; “Han” became the name of the people.

name: 新朝
feature: 王莽代汉建新，托古改制（王田、币制、官制），旋激化矛盾，亡于绿林赤眉，刘秀复汉。列主要人物，合计14年。
featureEn: Wang Mang usurped Han to found Xin, imposing antiquarian reforms (land, coinage, offices); the strife soon boiled over, and Xin fell to the Lulin and Chimei, after which Liu Xiu restored Han. Major figures, 14 yrs.
summary: 承汉启汉的短暂改制，制度实验影响后世。
summaryEn: A brief reforming interlude between two Hans; its institutional experiments influenced later ages.

name: 三国
feature: 魏蜀吴鼎立，群雄与智谋的演义舞台。三政权同时并存，以下年数不相加（存续以时期计）。
featureEn: Wei, Shu and Wu stood in a tripartite balance — a stage of heroes and stratagems. The three coexisted, so tenures are not summed (duration counted by period).
summary: 乱世英豪辈出，《三国演义》使其深入民心。
summaryEn: An age of rising heroes, immortalized by Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

name: 晋
feature: 短暂统一后长期分裂，门阀士族兴盛。列主要帝，合计约158年。
featureEn: Brief unity followed by long division; the gentry clans rose. Major emperors, ~158 yrs.
summary: 统一旋即崩解，开启南北长期对峙的过渡期。
summaryEn: Unity quickly collapsed, opening a long north–south standoff.

name: 南北朝
feature: 南北政权并立，民族大融合，佛教兴盛。南北同时在位，以下年数不相加（存续以时期计）。
featureEn: Northern and southern regimes coexisted, with great ethnic fusion and the spread of Buddhism. Tenures not summed (duration by period).
summary: 民族融合关键期，为隋唐盛世积蓄多元养分。
summaryEn: A key era of ethnic fusion, storing diverse nourishment for the Sui–Tang heyday.

name: 隋
feature: 重归一统，开创科举与大运河。
featureEn: Reunified the realm; founded the exam system and the Grand Canal.
summary: 制度创制(科举、运河)深远，短祚而承前启后。
summaryEn: Its institutions (exams, canal) had lasting impact; short-lived but bridging.

name: 唐
feature: 盛世开放，文化璀璨，万国来朝。列主要帝系（含武周），合计约290年。
featureEn: A cosmopolitan golden age of radiant culture, with all nations paying tribute. Major emperors (incl. Wu Zhou), ~290 yrs.
summary: 中国古代最强盛开放的时代之一，文化辐射整个东亚。
summaryEn: One of the strongest and most open eras of imperial China; its culture radiated across East Asia.

name: 五代十国
feature: 唐亡后中原五代更替、周边十国并立。列中原五代主要君主（十国并立不计入），合计53年。
featureEn: After Tang fell, five dynasties succeeded in the Central Plains while ten kingdoms stood around. Major Central Plains rulers (ten kingdoms excluded), 53 yrs.
summary: 大分裂尾声，武人乱政，终由宋重新统一。
summaryEn: The tail of great fragmentation, warlord misrule, ended by Song's reunification.

name: 辽
feature: 契丹建立，与北宋并立；澶渊之盟后长期对峙，末年为金所灭。
featureEn: Founded by the Khitan, standing alongside Northern Song; after the Chanyuan Treaty a long standoff, ended by Jin.
summary: 北方草原政权，创南北面官分治，影响深远。
summaryEn: A northern steppe polity that pioneered dual administration, with far-reaching influence.

name: 宋
feature: 重文轻武，经济文化科技鼎盛，词风尤盛。列主要帝，合计约319年。
featureEn: Civilian over military, with a pinnacle of economy, culture and science; ci poetry thrived. Major emperors, ~319 yrs.
summary: 文治巅峰而军事积弱，经济与市民文化空前繁荣。
summaryEn: A zenith of civil governance yet militarily weak; economy and urban culture unprecedented.

name: 西夏
feature: 党项羌建立，据河西走廊，创西夏文，与宋、辽、金鼎立，终亡于蒙古。
featureEn: Founded by the Tangut, holding the Hexi Corridor, created the Tangut script, standing with Song, Liao and Jin; fell to Mongols.
summary: 西北割据政权，佛教与番汉文化交融。
summaryEn: A northwestern regime where Buddhism and Tangut–Han culture blended.

name: 金
feature: 女真建立，灭辽亡北宋，与南宋对峙，后为蒙古所灭。
featureEn: Founded by the Jurchen, destroyed Liao and Northern Song, standing against Southern Song; fell to Mongols.
summary: 女真崛起于东北，推进汉制，终亡于蒙宋联军。
summaryEn: The Jurchen rose in the Northeast, advanced Han institutions, ended by the Mongol–Song alliance.

name: 元
feature: 蒙古建立的大一统王朝，疆域空前。列主要帝，合计约97年。
featureEn: A unified dynasty founded by the Mongols, with unprecedented territory. Major emperors, ~97 yrs.
summary: 首次由少数民族完成大一统，驿站连通欧亚。
summaryEn: First time a minority completed unification; relay stations linked Eurasia.

name: 明
feature: 汉族重建大一统，海禁与郑和下西洋并存。列主要帝，合计276年。
featureEn: Han restored unification; the sea ban coexisted with Zheng He's voyages. Major emperors, 276 yrs.
summary: 专制强化而商品经济活跃，海陆两端各有大动作。
summaryEn: Autocracy intensified yet a vibrant commodity economy; big moves by land and sea.

name: 清
feature: 中国最后王朝，前期疆域极盛，后期遭遇近代变局（努尔哈赤建后金1616为清前身）。列主要帝，合计约276年。
featureEn: China's last dynasty; at its height territory peaked, later hit by modern upheavals (Nurhaci founded Later Jin in 1616 as its precursor). Major emperors, ~276 yrs.
summary: 古代帝制终结篇，由盛转衰卷入世界体系。
summaryEn: The final chapter of imperial rule, turning from prosperity to decline as it entered the world system.
